scope: Fixed offline settlement/persistence scenarios supporting W10.1. They do not replace frozen acceptance criteria or establish full W4-W8/N7, model or human acceptance.

worlds.structure: Finite stock and wallets, actual player commute and three daily purchases, three NPCs with timed work/travel/rest plans.
worlds.daily_action: BUY one bread after reaching the market
worlds.final: Player credit76, bread3, shop stock7; each NPC completes its three six-step day plans and retains its long goal.

worlds.structure: Commerce disabled; three NPCs have authored contact semantics, cyclic speech and sourced heard memories. Player starts away, then joins the public scene.
worlds.daily_action: Day1 MOVE to square; days2/3 TALK to Lin
worlds.final: Each NPC pair has familiarity6 from six actual bilateral contact receipts, all nine plans complete; no private fact appears in public projection.

worlds.structure: Authored calendar and recurring one-hour local wage rule, three commuting NPC plans, three timed offscreen incidents and one intentionally unresolved incident.
worlds.daily_action: START_ROUTINE for the same authored one-hour work block, max_minutes60
worlds.final: Exactly three wages of2; three incidents resolve and one remains unresolved, no offscreen exposure delivered to the player.

boundaries: Before time advances, a missing MOVE destination and a TALK listener in another scene must refuse without changing canonical entities, clock or resolution receipts.
All ordinary Narrator calls fail with a controlled offline refusal; grounded fallback may describe only settled effects, never replay an action.
After each daily non-WAIT action and at each12-hour checkpoint, repeat the exact request and require identical response, unchanged current.json bytes and zero additional generation.
At hours12/36/60, recreate JsonStore, AIRuntime and GameService, compare complete authority, and repeat the previous request before continuing.
failure_standards: Schema-invalid save or clock delta differing from the exact paid checkpoint interval.
Duplicate receipt ID, changed previously seen receipt, or NPC work adding world time twice.
Plan cursor regression, completed-prefix reexecution, unexplained loss of an active long goal or premature completion before its not_before.
Wallet, stock, inventory, relationship or body changes without their declared authoritative settlement.
Missing/refused prerequisites causing world effects, private facts leaking, or unresolved background stages reported as resolved.
Restart/replay producing a changed response, extra generation, changed save bytes, repeated time/resources or lost plan state.
